alerts.headline: Freeze Warning issued October 15 at 9:44AM MDT until October 16 at 10:00AM MDT by NWS Grand Junction CO
alerts.description:
* WHAT...For the first Freeze Warning, sub-freezing temperatures as
low as 24 expected. For the second Freeze Warning, sub-freezing
temperatures as low as 27 expected.

* WHERE...Central Yampa River Basin, Lower Yampa River Basin, Upper
Yampa River Basin, San Juan River Basin, and Central Colorado River
Basin.

* WHEN...For the first Freeze Warning, from midnight tonight to 10 AM
MDT Friday. For the second Freeze Warning, from midnight Friday
Night to 10 AM MDT Saturday.

* IMPACTS...Frost and freeze conditions could kill crops, other
sensitive vegetation and possibly damage unprotected outdoor
plumbing.

alerts.title: I-70 Glenwood Canyon Bridge Joint Improvements-148524
alerts.description: Between Exit 129: Bair Ranch (6 miles west of the Dotsero area) and Exit 125: Hanging Lake (5 miles east of the No Name area) from Mile Point 126 to Mile Point 125. Right lane closed due to bridge construction. Starting tomorrow at 7:00AM MDT until tomorrow at about 7:00PM MDT. Full schedule below: • October 16, 7:00AM - October 16, 7:00PM Comment: Eastbound and westbound lane width restrictions, for commercial and recreational vehicles, are in effect 24 hours a day, 7 days a week. A commercial and recreational vehicle width limit of 11'-0" is in place for the duration of the project. Eastbound I-70 will be reduced to one lane from Mile Point 127 to 128. Westbound from Mile Point 125 to 126 on the east side of Hanging Lake Tunnel will be one-lane for bridge joint water testing. Daytime work hours will be 7 a.m. to 7 p.m., Monday through Friday. The speed limit will be reduced to 35 mph through the work zone.
